propositions: Projects cannot currently extend built-in code-review overlays with additional trigger tokens or glob patterns; they can only define standalone project.* criteria
The trigger functions glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays read only committed routing and hardcoded patterns, not project-level extensions

A project entry on a built-in overlay id with trigger_tokens (literal substring matches on added/removed diff lines) or applies_to globs should additively union with the committed overlay configuration
Trigger extensions must be read directly from the project routing file and threaded through the call site, not via effective_routing, to preserve union semantics rather than replacement
Malformed project trigger extensions (non-list tokens, non-string values, unknown ids) must be ignored silently without raising errors, matching existing project criterion behavior
